title: A Wonderful Private Walking Tour
text: Sofia met my friend and I at the port where our ship docked and we were immediately underway.  She is knowledgeable and charming.  She set a great pace on a pretty hot day.  She knows all about the city and shares her knowledge in a very accessible and enjoyable way.  We were both so glad that we booked the tour and recommend Sofia to anyone going to Seville.
author: PhilW978

title: Thank you Sophia for your professionalism, thoroughness and thoughtfulness!
text:
Thank you Sophia for your professionalism, thoroughness and thoughtfulness!  
We chose her because of the exceptional reviews and were not disappointed.

Sophia is very organized and flexible too.  We had a very informative tour at a good pace for 4.5 hours.  She is very helpful with advice before and after the tour.  Her recommendation for flamenco was spot on, as it was the best dance show in Spain!

We highly recommend Sophia to anyone who wants to experience Seville culture, history and sightseeing!

title: Thorough and well paced tour led by a very  knowledgeable and lovely guide
text: Sofia is amazing!  She communicated with us well before we arrived in Seville.  On the day of our tour she met us promptly at the designated time in the lobby of our hotel and provided an extensive overview of the sights along the way to the Cathedral, Alcazar, Maria Luisa Park, and Plaza de Sevilla.  She is very knowledgeable, engaging, warm and friendly.  The tour was all we hoped for and more.

title: A wonderful tour of Seville
text:
Sofia is an excellent tour guide. She met us at our hotel and led us through the city center, the Jewish Quarter, to the cathedral, to the Alcazar, on to the park de Maria Louisa, and finally to the Plaza de España. 

Sofia has excellent command of the English language - the very best of all guides we have had on our 18 day trip. She is extremely knowledgeable of the history of Spain and had great detail to share with us in each place we visited.
